summary: Petrobras filed a Form 6-K announcing that it did not exercise preemptive/tag-along rights under the existing Braskem shareholders agreement and signed a new shareholders agreement with Shine I FIP to establish joint control over Braskem. Petrobras retains its 36.1% stake (47% voting). The agreement requires consensus on all board and shareholder resolutions, with equal board and executive board appointments. Effectiveness requires completion of FIP's share transfer and approval by Braskem. This is a governance restructuring, not a typical corporate event; no financial terms disclosed.
